How it works

  1. Your MP4 is uploaded to the server and processed by the Python tool. Files are deleted right after.
  2. The container is rewritten: fast-start layout, first-frame SEI stripped, avcC / bitrate boxes patched.
  3. “Ghost frames” are appended to the video tables – all pointing at one 8-byte filler block.
  4. No pixel changes, no re-encoding. File grows only by the metadata tables (~100 KB for 1 minute at 60fps).

Platforms can change their upload checks at any time, so results are not guaranteed. Max upload size is set by the server (default 500 MB).
